scope: REPORTED completed assertions; literal clocks, saved rows, HTTP and a real DOM only. The count of RECORDED clean reps for the trader’s own account: the three criteria Ep 32 names (plan-aligned, executed cleanly, journalled on the close day) read as recorded facts from the trades the app already stores, its own checklist rows, its own hash-verified journal acknowledgement and its own execution review. TRADES are counted, never calendar days; the start and the target are the trader’s own two settings values (no schema object, no backfill); an unstarted count is `counted:null` and an unreadable read is `unavailable`, never 0. No broker, provider, mental-state, pixel or production proof, and NO causal claim joining a rep to a result (the payload says so). RAW failures/early aborts and DECLARED assumptions stay separate. DECLARED NEGATIVE carried here by name: the inherited M99/M101 reviews cohort is STALE at this HEAD — 157/3 against its committed 159/1 (migration 12/3), because the schema grew after M101 (accounts 26->36 columns and 10 delivered-only tables), which the M108-era evidence did not contain. The three gaps are declared here, not repaired in the probe.
